name: Celestial Servant
description:
The reputation of your ancestors' service to the gods is still intact.

Whenever you interact with a deity or magical creature for the first time, they will assume you are a non-threatening servant and will continue to think so unless you target them with an attack, speak rudely to them, disobey orders they give you or otherwise anger them.

While you maintain this status:

  • All your opposed skill checks against the deity or magical creature are favored.

  • Whenever you use the Help action to enhance an ally's skill check, they get a +2d bonus instead of the normal +1d.

Describe how you pass for the help.
